name: Quartzwood Crasher
oracle_text:
Trample
Whenever one or more creatures you control with trample deal combat damage to a player, create an X/X green Dinosaur Beast creature token with trample, where X is the amount of damage those creatures dealt to that player.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more creatures you control with trample deal combat damage to a player, create an X/X green Dinosaur Beast creature token with trample, where X is the amount of damage those creatures dealt to that player.

needs.what: a value reading the total combat damage that the creatures bound by a batched creatures_deal_combat_damage trigger (narrowed by its filter, per damaged player under per_player) dealt to that player in this damage step, usable as create_token power/toughness
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The CREATURES_DEALT_COMBAT_DAMAGE payload built by combat._fire_damage_batch carries only damagers, damaged, damaged_battles and hits (oid lists), no amounts, so {"binding": "amount"} is unbound on it; damage_dealt_to_this_turn / damage_taken_this_turn count the whole turn and every source, not just the trample creatures in this batch. Secondary: _matching_damagers checks the filter against the printed face, so a creature granted trample would not count as 'with trample'
